name: placed
applies_to: every game of rules/chess.gdl and its variants
says: The placed questions of layer 2 (rust/engine/game/src/placed.rs) said over the description's own relations. A question about a unit that stands where the question puts it is asked of the board with that unit given: the state of the question holds the unit as a `cell` fluent on the place (what was there is replaced), the side that owns it to move, and no passed-over place; the definitions below then read the description's own relations of the unit's movement and of what a move takes, and add no rule of the game. A relation is only an alias where the description already has the relation.

questions.says: what stands where: the unit of a side and a kind on a place
the places a unit of a kind and a side standing on a place bears on, the board as it stands (its own side's units guarded, what lies behind a unit hidden)
the places a unit of a kind and a side standing on a place may move to in one move, the board as it stands (the safety of its side's goal unit not read)
the places a side's units bear on, the board as it stands
the places an allowed move of a side starts from and ends on (a move onto the last row names the unit it becomes in its term; its ends are the same)
the kind of the unit that plays an allowed move
the kind of the unit an allowed move takes, where it takes one (a taking in passing included)
